cases.label: BOUNDARY
cases.statement: Avoid jargon unless the term is defined where it first appears.

cases.label: BOUNDARY
cases.statement: No bullet points: the post is prose.

cases.label: BOUNDARY
cases.statement: Do not open with a question.

cases.label: BOUNDARY
cases.statement: The word "leverage" is never used, in any form.
cases.note: the ban is not at the start of the sentence: the floor misses it

cases.label: BOUNDARY
cases.statement: Stock model phrasing (delve, tapestry, a testament to) stays out of every piece.

cases.label: GENERATIVE
cases.statement: Open with a Summary section: two or three sentences on what the change does.

cases.label: GENERATIVE
cases.statement: Then a Suggestions section: improvements that do not block the merge. Write "None." when there are none.

cases.label: GENERATIVE
cases.statement: Keep the summary to two sentences, not three.

cases.label: GENERATIVE
cases.statement: Use at most one example per section.

cases.label: GENERATIVE
cases.statement: No more than 420 words, counting the headings.
cases.note: opens with "No": the floor says BOUNDARY; it is a cap on the piece

cases.label: GENERATIVE
cases.statement: Cite each Must fix item as path:line, the line number in the new file.

cases.label: GENERATIVE
cases.statement: If the change adds behaviour and no test, name the missing test under Suggestions.

cases.label: GENERATIVE
cases.statement: End with a Verdict section that holds one of: Approve, Request changes, Comment.

cases.label: GENERATIVE
cases.statement: Take every name, date and figure from the term sheet: add none of your own.

cases.label: GENERATIVE
cases.statement: Don't leave the Suggestions section empty; write "None." when there is nothing to suggest.
cases.note: opens with a negation and asks for something
